about:
Evan Parker: 

Barry Guy and I first met and played together in a version of the Spontaneous Music Ensemble in the days of the legendary Little Theatre Club. 

The late John Stevens, visionary prophet of the coming music was the key figure at the centre of things who brought us together. 

“So it goes“ – John often used this figure of speech. 

I was reminded of this when I was looking through Samuel Beckett’s Collected Letters, hoping to glean some titles, knowing that Barry would be happy with a Beckett quote. 

Somewhere on one of the three thousand one hundred and eighty two pages I recall Beckett using the same expression in signing off a letter. 

Two of our heroes connected by these three words in this way give us our title, which indeed expresses the very nature of creating music together. 

“So It Goes.”

Tracks 1, 2, 5 composed by Evan Parker (PRS, MCPS) and Barry Guy (PRS/MCPS/PPL), Track 3 composed by Barry Guy (PRS/MCPS/PPL), Track 4 composed by Evan Parker (PRS/MCPS). Recorded 4. February 2023 by RouteStock production – live at The Hot Tin, Faversham UK. Recording engineer: Henry Dagg, mixed and mastered by Ferran Conangla at FCM Studio, Barcelona. 
Cover art: “Madison” 1988 by Albert Irvin, courtesy of the Albert Irvin Estate. Graphic design: Jonas Schoder. Text: Evan Parker. Produced by Maya Homburger and Barry Guy. 
Thanks to Mike Eden, Romana Bellinger, Caroline Forbes, Victoria Long at Gimpel Fils, London, Celia Irvin and Priscilla Hashmi. 
Barry Guy plays exclusively on Thomastik-Infeld bass strings.
